upstream.description: Development workflows for Claude Code that keep broad exploration focused on the outcome you approved.

classification.analysis: claude-code-workflows is a Claude Code plugin marketplace of slash-command recipes, subagents, and skills that structure larger development changes into staged phases: scope agreement, design-doc review, task planning with gap tracking, per-task implementation with verification, and an independent final security/design review. It ships separate plugins for backend, frontend (React/TypeScript), and full-stack work, each bundling ~20 specialized subagents (code-reviewer, security-reviewer, task-decomposer, design-sync, etc.) and reference skills (coding-principles, testing-principles, typescript-rules). It's aimed at teams and solo developers using Claude Code who want repeatable, auditable convergence on non-trivial changes rather than open-ended exploration, installed via `/plugin marketplace add`.

use_cases.title: Install a Claude Code plugin that gates large changes behind design review and task planning
Run a scoped end-to-end feature implementation with independent security review
Standardize a team's Claude Code usage with a shared marketplace plugin
Design a React/TypeScript frontend feature with a UI-spec-driven recipe
